text_block_list.text: A few days had passed since the shocking news—perhaps out of anxiety, Eishin Flash's movements lacked their usual brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Fula-san~
Guess I take the win this time, then-

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I made my move five seconds later than planned.
A rookie mistake.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I was thinking while we were running...
is Flash-san acting kinda weird?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Usually it comes in with a sharp 'whoosh,' but today it's more like a weak 'poof'... y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I dunno, it's hard to explain, but~
it's missing that *zing*... or like, that heart-fluttering *thump*♪, you know?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Tosen Jordan, thanks for pacing with me!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yep, thankss~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Besides, coming from an older generation, she has plenty of experience.
...She saw through my mistakes right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If she faces experienced senior runners in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...

She must be thinking of the Umamusume she saw on the news.
Naturally, they pose a threat, but what worries me even more is...
choice_data_list: There's no problem as long as you make your move without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...However, making a careless move
will lead to a critical mistake."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I won't be able to beat everyone like this.
Yet doing nothing leads to the same result... In fact, it would likely leave me feeling even more unsatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...In that case, shouldn't we
reconsider the race schedule itself?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...The tougher the battle gets,
the more exhausted I become.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For instance, by adjusting your schedule to skip GⅠ races expected to have fierce finishing battles... you could focus entirely on the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
choice_data_list: I think it'll be fine if we build up your skills, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really think so?
choice_data_list: Is that really what you want, Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, please let me think about it for a bit.

That night, Eishin Flash sent me an email
with an updated, readjusted schedule attached.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Reconsidering entry plans for the Osaka Hai and Tenno Sho (Spring), opting to run in GⅡ and GⅢ races instead."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "All of this is to smoothly arrive at the Tenno Sho (Autumn) in peak condition—"

I called Eishin Flash over to discuss
that conservative change of plans.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Rather than risking a crushing defeat, I judged that it
was wiser to choose a path that guarantees consistent results."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Competing against Senior tier runners in a GⅠ
will surely wear you out and lead to more mistakes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, I might end up putting on
a pitiful performance at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
...Right in front of my parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, rather than stubbornly sticking to our initial plan,
we should think more flexibly."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Just like you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Both before and after the Derby,
your flexible thinking has kept pushing me forward."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"This is a positive change, Trainer.
For who I am right now—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The schedule I submitted is the absolute "best" conceivable option.
She claimed she was staying positive, but... right now, she seems excessively afraid of failure.

What is needed is not schedule adjustments,
but facing oneself. For that...
we must first soothe that anguished heart.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —So, you came to ask Falco for advice?
choice_data_list: I figured you'd know, since you know Flash so well.
I figured you'd know, since you know Flash so well.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, who knows☆ But I do keep
a close eye on Flash-san in the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "...That's why I understand why Flash-san is brooding so much right now."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: You see, what Flash-san needs right now is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I think of the blue sea and white sandy beaches♪
